root_causes.cause: write_file/edit_file committed newly introduced source syntax errors without a precommit parser check
repair TaskRuntime attempt could settle success before the affected verifier decided the mutation
diagnostic progress accepted changed or smaller signatures even when new diagnostics were introduced
stale journal snapshots appended competing WAITING_BARRIER payloads under one idempotency key and wake routing replayed non-authoritative notifications
the physical request narrowed tools to forced edit_file, but provider-returned read_file calls were checked against the earlier broad semantic tool set and executed
synchronous historical recovery blocked backend readiness and a fresh restart-replay lifecycle nonce conflicted with the orphaned same-run claim

final-request tool-surface rejection raised before decision decoding, so the existing mutation-required retry loop never received the contract violation and the Director repair turn terminated without an edit

FactStream head and current-checkpoint catch-up deserialized the full 38.6 MB task_runtime.execution history on every wake; the backend saturated one CPU and Factory status queries timed out while no new event existed

a mutation-required forced edit_file response was validated by tool name only; empty search reached the physical executor, whose safety no-op was then committed as an authoritative successful effect receipt without before/after hashes

Factory's 100 ms claimability/status observation repeatedly rebuilt the same task_runtime.execution projection; L1-04's 40 MiB/765-fact history was reread at approximately 88 MiB per 2 seconds, saturating the backend event-loop CPU before the Director repair LLM call

every non-strict query and append reparsed the complete append-only stream; dynamic slow-scan call stacks showed Run Ledger artifact/verification joins, TaskRuntime claims, and settlement checkpoint verification repeatedly consuming the same 40 MiB execution stream and 12 MiB settlement stream
bootstrap decisions froze read_file as readonly_serial even after ToolSpecRegistry made readonly_parallel authoritative; ToolBatch correctly rejected the stale execution_mode before recovery reads
the invoker wrapped the exact tool-surface guard marker with 'LLM call failed:' while same-turn recovery recognized only an offset-zero marker

process cancellation after the durable stage_completed event and strict checkpoint pointer but before the commit marker ACK created cancelled_before_commit_ack quarantine that no later exact retry could discharge

root_causes.owner: roles.kernel final-request authority and roles.adapters DEO mutation port
root_causes.cause: non-stream normalized native calls validated only nested function.arguments; top-level empty edit arguments bypassed the guard, and a physical ok=true/no_op=true result was committed and counted as an authoritative successful mutation

edit_file declared only file as required and did not encode that blocks, search+replace, or start_line+end_line+content must exist; the forced Anthropic-compatible request therefore admitted a file-only native call that could never mutate. The alternate direct Anthropic schema projection also removed required entirely

fixes.change: add UTF-8 content syntax check for supported source files
reject only newly introduced definite syntax failure before physical write/edit
hold repair lease and defer TaskRuntime settlement until post-repair verifier decision
progress requires strict diagnostic subset with no introduced signature
CAS append from current replay sequence, bounded conflict reload, exact barrier reuse, non-contiguous replay rejection
replay only authoritative TaskRuntime and Run Ledger notifications; acknowledge observer, malformed, incomplete, and unknown messages without replay
make the physically dispatched final request tools/tool_choice authoritative; normalize aliases and fail closed on provider calls outside that surface
reject out-of-surface streamed tool calls before any tool event reaches the transaction executor
apply the same final-request tool-surface guard to non-stream provider responses
launch historical Factory recovery in background so application readiness is not blocked
resume the exact orphaned restart-replay lifecycle claim for the same run instead of creating a conflicting nonce
route an exact provider tool-surface violation into the existing bounded mutation retry in the same Director turn and authority; do not execute the rejected tool or restart PM/CE
keep repeated out-of-surface provider calls inside the existing bounded mutation retry budget and fail closed after exhaustion
add descriptor-verified bounded tail reads so event-stream head queries do not read the full append history
derive a non-strict stream head from the last valid JSONL envelope while preserving full scans for strict-integrity callers
use the FactStream head port to skip source page reads when the durable head already equals the validated settlement checkpoint

validate provider edit_file arguments against search/replace, line-range, or blocks mode before DEO admission; route empty search through the same bounded Director mutation retry instead of committing a no-op receipt
cache the projected latest task rows across service instances by workspace, limit, and descriptor-bound durable stream head; any append advances the head and invalidates the projection immediately
reuse TaskRuntime scope facts across repeated artifact and verifier authority queries while the durable stream head is unchanged

cache parsed non-strict EventEnvelope sequences behind the descriptor lock and durable tail head; publish the advanced cache atomically after append, retain full validation for strict-integrity reads, and emit slow full-scan call paths for proactive diagnosis
capture current ToolSpecRegistry semantics when synthesizing bootstrap reads and reclassify serialized invocations at execution, ignoring stale effect/mode hints
unwrap only platform-owned provider error prefixes before matching the exact tool-surface violation marker; arbitrary marker-containing text remains non-authoritative

classify only an exact cancelled_before_commit_ack event as recoverable, prove event/intent/checkpoint/pointer identity, restore the strict checkpoint, append the missing canonical commit marker, and clear only that exact cancellation quarantine before same-stage reentry

validate tool name and arguments identically for nested OpenAI and normalized top-level native envelopes; empty-search edit calls are rejected before DEO and stay in bounded same-turn Director recovery
terminalize a proven physical no-op without committing receipt_outcome=succeeded
exclude explicit no-op rows from authoritative mutation success and classify director_write_no_effect as bounded same-turn replannable
preserve required in Anthropic-native schemas and project edit_file anyOf constraints so file-only calls are invalid at the physical provider boundary
